description:
Overall Job Description: 
 We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Wireless Engineering team. Candidate will be a key contributor to develop and generate customized software solutions. Candidate is also responsible to write detailed guidelines, procedures to execute various operations in the wireless network.
 Tasks and Responsibilities: 
 Develop customized software solutions and tools.
 Lead the effort in identifying automation and scripting needs
 Provide detailed procedures and operational aspects of the Samsung products to various wireless carriers and other vendors
 Help in providing scripts/tools and documentation to assist the operator in carrying out the complex network operations and understand the Wireless network.
 Lead the effort in identifying a problem in production of the tools/script
 Key Competencies: 
 Experience in software solution design and development.
 Experience with scripting: Python, PERL, shell, TCL, AWK etc
 Experience with C/C++/Java development
 Experience with Unix, Oracle, SQL and PL/SQL
 Experience in ETL scripting
 Experience in DB design
 Experience with socket programming
 Automation of scheduled tasks
 Experience with Graphical User Interface design
 Experience in Processing of high volume of data
 Exposure to High Availability and redundancy systems
 Good understanding of Sun Solaris operating System and Linux.
 Basic understanding of call processing in wireless networks is desired
 
 Education and Experience Required: 
 5+ years of experience in software industry with tool development
 BS/MS in EE/CS is mandatory
 Understanding of wireless networks, architecture and protocols is required
 Understanding of LTE networks/protocols is desired
 Experience with SNMP, TR-69 and TNM protocols is desired
 Good communication skill and problem solving skills are required
 
 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: Long Term 
 Preferably from DC/MD/VA locations
